about.text: A journey of craftsmanship, passion, and timeless design since 2010

ÆTHER was born from a simple yet profound belief: that our surroundings profoundly shape our experiences. Founded in 2010 by interior designer Elena Vasquez, our studio began as a small atelier dedicated to creating pieces that bridge the gap between art and function.

What started as a passion project has grown into a globally recognized brand, but our core philosophy remains unchanged. We believe in slow design—taking the time to understand materials, honor craftsmanship, and create pieces that will be cherished for generations.
"Design is not just about how things look—it's about how they make you feel, how they shape your daily rituals, and how they become part of your story." — Elena Vasquez
We source only the finest materials and partner with master artisans who share our dedication to excellence. Every piece undergoes rigorous quality checks before it reaches your home.
Each piece is handcrafted by skilled artisans using techniques perfected over generations. We celebrate the human touch and the beauty of imperfection.
We're committed to ethical sourcing, minimal waste, and creating pieces designed to last a lifetime. Sustainability isn't a trend—it's our responsibility.
To create thoughtfully designed objects that elevate everyday living, celebrating the intersection of form, function, and the human experience.

Our commitment to quality begins with material selection. We work directly with suppliers who share our values, sourcing premium woods, natural fibers, and sustainable materials from around the world.

Each piece is then brought to life by our network of master artisans—potteries in Portugal, textile weavers in India, and woodworkers in Japan—who apply techniques refined over centuries. The result is furniture and decor that carries the story of its making.
Elena Vasquez opens a small studio in Brooklyn, crafting custom furniture and decor pieces for local clients.
Launch of our first signature collection, "Elemental," featuring organic forms and sustainable materials.
ÆTHER is featured in Architectural Digest and opens its first flagship showroom in Manhattan.
Launch of our virtual design studio, allowing clients worldwide to collaborate with our designers remotely.
Achieving 98% sustainable sourcing and launching our circular design initiative.
With over 20 years of experience in interior design, Elena leads our creative vision and ensures every piece reflects our commitment to timeless elegance.
Marcus brings a background in architecture and furniture design, creating pieces that balance structural integrity with organic beauty.
Sophia leads our ethical sourcing initiatives and ensures our practices align with our commitment to environmental responsibility.
With 30 years of woodworking experience, David brings unparalleled skill and attention to detail to every piece he touches.
We believe in creating pieces that stand the test of time—both in quality and in meaning. Every ÆTHER piece is designed to be cherished for generations.

We offer free standard shipping on all orders over $100 within the continental US. Orders typically ship within 1-2 business days and arrive in 3-7 business days. Express shipping options are available at checkout for an additional fee. International shipping rates vary by destination.

We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for unused items in original packaging. Custom and personalized items are final sale. To initiate a return, please contact our customer service team with your order number. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive the returned item.
Do you offer custom design services?

Yes! We specialize in custom interior design solutions. Our team works closely with you to create bespoke pieces that perfectly complement your space. Contact our design team to schedule a consultation and discuss your vision, budget, and timeline.
How do I care for my products?

Care instructions vary by material. For ceramics and glass, hand wash with mild soap and dry immediately. For textiles, spot clean or dry clean as recommended. For wood items, dust with a soft cloth and avoid direct sunlight. Detailed care instructions are included with each product.

Yes, we ship to most countries worldwide. International shipping rates are calculated at checkout based on destination and order weight. Please note that customers are responsible for any customs duties or taxes imposed by their country. Delivery times vary by location.

product-details.text:
Handcrafted from premium ceramic, this sculptural vase brings organic elegance to any interior. 
                Its unique form creates visual interest while the matte finish adds subtle sophistication. 
                Perfect for dried arrangements or as a standalone art piece.

The Sculptural Ceramic Vase is a testament to artisanal craftsmanship. Each piece is hand-thrown by skilled potters, resulting in subtle variations that make every vase truly one-of-a-kind.Design PhilosophyInspired by organic forms found in nature, this vase features flowing curves that create a sense of movement and tranquility. The matte finish catches light beautifully, while the weighted base ensures stability.Care InstructionsClean with a soft, dry cloth. For stubborn marks, use a slightly damp cloth and dry immediately. Not dishwasher safe. Avoid exposing to extreme temperature changes.
